transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, I'm wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can start light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. It’s best to avoid heavy work or lifting for 1 month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thank you for that information. My next question is about my eye gel for dry eyes. When can I start using that again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light right now. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: A bit of light sensitivity can be normal as your eyes adjust. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside can help. But if the bright light causes significant pain, or your eye is red and painful, that is not normal and should be checked. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I have for now. Thank you for your help.
